latest.title: A finite set with noncompact closed convex hull in a Hadamard space
latest.abstract: We show that the closed convex hull of a finite set in a Hadamard space can be noncompact by providing an AI-generated construction. The seemingly innocuous problem of finding such a set or showing that none exists, recorded by Gromov and periodically revisited by researchers in metric geometry, functional analysis, fixed-point theory, and geometric group theory, remained unanswered for over three decades. The construction itself is based on building an inductive sequence of CAT(1) metric graphs and taking the Euclidean cone over the limiting space. We discuss the history of this problem, explain the construction and its relationship with existing techniques, and mention some related questions.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 作者给出 Hadamard 空间中有限集闭凸包非紧的 AI 生成构造，否定长期悬而未决的紧性期待。
latest.breakthrough: 展示非正曲率并不足以保证有限生成闭凸包紧性。
latest.limitations: 须核查极限完备性、CAT 条件及非紧证明；不能推及局部紧 Hadamard 空间。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.aiEvidence: 英文摘要明确称其反例为 AI-generated construction。
latest.priorityReason: 直接命中 CAT 空间核心问题，构造潜在影响很高。
